items.text: Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring) Week 5 vs NYG; Daniels ACTIVE/returning (elbow brace). McNichols OUT.
items.why: Hamstring DNP; Daniels full practice upgraded, starts.
items.implication: WSH pass game with Daniels back but Diggs absent; McLaurin Q.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for McLaurin/Okonkwo/Van Jefferson elevate; Daniels rushing/passing volume.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details complete. Houston among teams with interest, possible reunion with Stroud.
items.why: Trade finalizing; team informed player morning of game.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production Week 5; long-term departure from ARI offense.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining ARI WRs especially Michael Wilson.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT Week 5 (hamstring); missed practices, week-to-week.
items.implication: Zero Week 5; Shipley/Pierce elevated for PHI RB duties vs JAX.
items.opportunity: PHI RB committee snaps/carries/red-zone to backups; Goedert targets up with Smith also out.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT Week 5 (left ankle) vs ATL; Tyler Huntley starts. Flowers Q (foot).
items.why: Ankle; missed practices after early exit prior week.
items.implication: Major BAL offense downgrade; Huntley limits ceiling for pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Likely/Andrews/Flowers volume but lower efficiency/QB play; reverse if Lamar returns next.
corroboration: Matthew Berry note on Huntley downgrade

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT Week 5 (hamstring); Goedert fully cleared/IN after knee, elevated target role with Smith/Wicks issues.
items.why: Hamstring DNP all week; Goedert FP Fri no designation.
items.implication: PHI WR/TE volume concentrates on Goedert/Wicks (if active)/Brown out.
items.opportunity: Goedert TE1 upside 8-10+ targets red-zone vs JAX.

items.text: Justin Jefferson Q (ankle, limited all week); Jordan Addison Q (hamstring). Vikings elevate OBJ for depth/insurance.
items.implication: GTD; if both limited Hockenson/others surge vs NO.
items.opportunity: If Jefferson sits, Addison/Hock volume; monitor early window.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty QUESTIONABLE (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby. Declining practice (full->limited->DNP).
items.implication: GTD; if OUT Hemby/backup carries surge vs NE.
items.opportunity: If inactive, clear path for Hemby goal-line/third-down; monitor 90-min window.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT Week 5 (quad) vs CLE; second straight miss. Jets activate Tim Patrick (no designation).
items.implication: NYJ RB volume to backups; Patrick adds WR depth.
items.opportunity: Jets RB committee expansion; Wilson/Garrett Wilson routes steady.

items.text: Steelers place Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot); misses minimum 4 games.
items.implication: PIT WR depth thins; Metcalf/others volume up ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf routes/targets expand; Dowdle Q toe.

items.text: MHJ has just 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor in Michael Wilson's production; inactive/trade opens Kia Kendrick Bourne season (jokingly Mazda Marv).
items.why: MHJ low volume (5/4); Wilson independent; Bourne opportunity post-inactive.
items.implication: Wilson already producing without MHJ; Bourne/Wilson elevated roles ROS in ARI.
items.opportunity: Wilson target share/routes expand further vs DET; Bourne volume bump.

items.text: Quentin Johnston OUT Week 5 (chest) vs DEN; limited late week but ruled out. McConkey Q (foot, DNP week).
items.implication: LAC WR room depleted; Herbert options limited.
items.opportunity: If McConkey sits too, deeper WRs/TE volume; else McConkey high share.

items.text: Dallas Goedert IN (knee full); Jeremiyah Love IN (ankle no designation, full speed). Daniels/Olave expected play.
items.why: Upgraded FP/no listing; Love practicing full despite ankle notes.
items.implication: Goedert TE1 with PHI WRs out; Love RB role clear vs DET.
items.opportunity: Love carries/snaps post-Allgeier; Goedert red-zone; Olave routes if cleared.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase QUESTIONABLE (concussion protocol); Tee Higgins Q (groin/neck). If out, Gesicki/Meyers volume spike.
items.why: Protocol ongoing; limited/no full practice clarity.
items.implication: GTD monitor inactives; Burrow targets redistribute if sit.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Chase Brown receiving + TE/WR2 upside.

items.text: LOVE Michael Wilson WR10 vs DET: volume including red zone; MHJ inactive boosts further.
items.why: Target hog + DET matchup; post-MHJ confirmation.

items.text: LOVE Nico Collins WR8 @ TEN: target-hog volume including RZ vs soft Titans secondary.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high target floor.

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown RB5 @ MIA: gobbles targets/fantasy pts (Brown Gobbler); usage + matchup, Cincy injuries help.
items.why: Workload/targets + soft MIA run D; Chase/Higgins Q.

items.text: LOVE Isaiah Likely TE5 @ WSH and Christian Watson WR15 vs CHI: matchup/coverage weaknesses + volume.
items.why: Positional mismatches; Lamar out helps Likely security.
items.opportunity: Likely targets if Nabers limited; Watson deep/RZ.

items.text: HATE Jordan Addison WR41 @ NO (injury wrinkle/tough), Mark Andrews TE17 @ ATL (role/usage), Cam Skattebo RB20 @ WSH (efficiency/game env), Tony Pollard, Jalen Hurts QB15 (rough stretch/line).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, poor efficiency, banged line for Hurts.
items.conflict: Usage may still support some if volume high.
